capabilities: redeem a one-time invitation link to link a device
open related report texts and images
reconnect automatically with the saved device credential
disambiguation: Despite the name suggesting AI, the README describes no AI features; it is a gated remote report viewer.
extras: Invitation-only with no public signup or payment; install alone grants no access. Source is available only privately to the Obsidian review system. Viewing is not DRM: screenshots and content extraction are possible. No mobile support; Windows and macOS only. A Korean-language description duplicates the English documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse externally hosted, access-controlled investment reports and their classification mapping inside the app.
summary: Invitation-only reader that shows a classification map of investment reports and opens the related report text and images from the operator's AWS service.
